title: Chapter 298
text:
In the group stages, Long Sky's momentum was suppressed by Dynasty and Fried Eggplants with Fish time and time again. Being highly anticipated was a double-edged sword. When Long Sky's performance was not satisfactory, the media's comments were all negative, and they were not optimistic about whether Long Sky could make it out of the group stages.

As a veteran team, Long Sky's ability to withstand pressure was very strong. The last few matches of Group A had reached a new high, but in the match against Dynasty, King Admiral had defeated four of them in one go. Dynasty had steadily climbed to the top of the group and was basically guaranteed to advance. Now, there was only one spot left, and Long Sky's points dropped to fourth.

Amidst the negative comments, the last round began. Long Sky's opponent was Fried Eggplants with Fish, who was in second place. The difference in points between the two teams was very high, and if they wanted to replace them, they would have to crush Fried Eggplants with Fish with absolute advantage. However, Fried Eggplants with Fish was also a powerhouse team, and Long Sky clearly did not stand a chance.

However, Long Sky, who the audience thought was done for, turned the tables around. Hao Tian and the rest of the team seemed to be on steroids and fought a perfect team battle, crushing Fried Eggplants with Fish. In the group stages, Long Sky could be said to have zero mistakes, crushing Fried Eggplants with Fish to the ground. The 'Three Chariots' [Dancing Fish Dragon], [Fragrant Bear], and [Sun Eggplant] were all stunned by Long Sky's explosive moves.

On the broadcast screen of the match, the bullet screen was in a state of frenzy every minute and every second, densely packed and surging like the sea. The fans of both sides were nervous, and every time there was a critical turn, it would cause the audience to cry out in alarm.

Long Sky's points increased tremendously, and they shared the points with Fried Eggplants with Fish. In the end, Long Sky surpassed Fried Eggplants with Fish in second place.

"Long Sky's shocking comeback!"

"Fried Eggplants with Fish lost miserably!"

"Long Sky's momentum is as high as the rainbow, Finger Sword Champion!"

"Fried Eggplants with Fish is eliminated. The Radiance of the Powerhouses is gone!"

"Group A's qualifiers have been decided. Dynasty and Long Sky enter the finals!"

Long Sky turned the tables around, and the forums exploded. Long Sky's fans were so excited that it was as if they were celebrating the New Year. The media, which was originally pessimistic, changed their direction once again, and all of them praised Long Sky. No matter how pessimistic they were before the match, they would support whoever won.

Dynasty, Long Sky, and Fried Eggplants with Fish held a press conference together after the match. The reporters first congratulated Dynasty and Long Sky for making it to the next round, and the spokespersons of these two powerhouses spoke with confidence and assurance. They said a series of polite words, which were mostly about performing well, thanking the audience for their support, and so on.

Finally, the reporter turned to Fried Eggplants with Fish and asked, "You were eliminated and did not make it to the finals. What do you think?"

"This is not a good result, and it is not in line with our expectations. In the competition, we made many mistakes, and we should have been able to do better. Long Sky is a very strong team, and their strength speaks for itself," the spokesperson for Fried Eggplants with Fish said with a heavy expression.

This was a prepared speech. First, they would admit that they did not perform well, make a self-reflection, and apologize to the fans. This was the standard procedure, and the reporters were patient. They did not even bother to write a record.

Suddenly, the team leader, Sun Eggplant, stood up. Although he was the last in the nickname 'Fried Eggplants with Fish', he was the leader of the trio.

Sun Eggplant grabbed the microphone from the spokesperson and interrupted the speech. Facing the confused gazes of the crowd, he stared at Long Sky and said in a deep voice, "I don't want to say bullsh * t like I tried my best. The truth is, I lost, and I am not satisfied. I will win next time. Hao Tian, we are both in the top sixteen of the individual competition. If you meet me, you can just wait to be eliminated."

Hao Tian was very stubborn. "You can't beat me this time, and it will be the same next time."

The two stared at each other and did not give in.

Only such a heated conversation would be interesting. The reporters were excited and hurriedly recorded it.

The people from Dynasty looked at them from the side. The first place in their group had become a foil.

Second Prince clenched his fist and said in dissatisfaction, "The reporters are not interviewing us. I might as well go and challenge …"

King Admiral's eyelids were drooping, and he seemed to be dozing off. Hearing this, he casually slapped the back of Second Prince's head and said, "Don't join in the fun."

Second Prince slapped King Admiral's hand away and said with dissatisfaction, "You're f * cking hitting me again. What does it have to do with you that I'm going to challenge?"

"Idiot, you didn't even enter the top sixteen of the individual competition. Why are you joining in the fun?" King Admiral's casual tone pierced through Second Prince's heart.

A red cloud appeared on Second Prince's face as he stared at King Admiral angrily. He wanted to give him a round of Friendship Break Face Kick and a round of Give Me Back My Pretty Fist.

He felt that this was a blatant mockery. King Admiral had entered the individual competition and was the champion of the individual competition. He had been invited to the International All-Star Competition, but he had been eliminated. Second Prince was very upset.

At the same time, Temple of God was also holding a press conference. Temple of God was very lucky, and they were placed in a weaker group. Since they had the highest points, they were also invited to the All-Star Competition.

Li Ge spoke eloquently at the press conference, saying that they would definitely win glory for the country in international competitions, win glory, represent China, and win back trophies and so on.

Temple of God considered themselves as the leader of the top teams, and Li Ge had always walked the path of representing China. Although he was the second Chinese player in the international competition, King Admiral was very low profile and had a sloppy image. On the other hand, Li Ge was handsome and strong, so he was very popular and had a lot of fans.

His fans were more female, while King Admiral's fans were mostly burly men. When the fans of both sides fought, it could be said to be the biggest show of the year. As long as King Admiral and Li Ge had a direct confrontation, it would be time for this show to start.

The teams and players that had made it out of the Regular Season all held press conferences. There were all kinds of attitudes. Some said that they would be the champions, while others kept a low profile.

At this point, the list for the Division Finals was out.

Top eight: China's five teams — Dynasty, Long Sky, Temple of God, Thunder Storm, and Nine Gates. Three foreign teams — Son of Wind, Raging Beast, and Orange Gold.

Top sixteen: King Admiral, Sun Eggplant, Hao Tian, Li Ge, Mad Blade, Rainy Kim …

Looking at this list, Han Xiao smiled. He smiled like an old farmer who had a good harvest.

"Heh heh, quite a few of them were famous players from my previous life." Han Xiao smiled. There was another reason why he was paying attention to the competition. To him, the Pro League was a chance to find experts.

Those who were able to enter the finals of the Planet Aquamarine division were all talents, and they were also good with words. The Great Mechanic Han was prepared to bring a portion of the strong players into the galaxy. This time, he would not only bring a few people but also a large group of players to be his fighters!

They would not die and could be revived. Players were very useful helpers. Although they were a little weak, there was room for improvement in the future versions. Although robots could be used as cannon fodder, robots cost money!

Players were free!

Han Xiao planned to train a group of people. He had to start from the very beginning. He already had an idea.

Build his own faction!

In Version 0, the players did not have a channel to go into the galaxy. If he could provide this channel, even the pro players would go crazy. Although Han Xiao's mission quota was not small, it was not a lot after splitting it. This limited the number of players he could train. However, going into the galaxy would give the players the opportunity to come into contact with the wider world. There would be endless missions, which was very attractive to the players. It was even more attractive than himself, thus breaking free from the limit of the mission quota.

The players going into the galaxy first was equivalent to seizing the opportunity. No one would not be envious of this opportunity. At the same time, he would be able to increase his sense of presence and create a huge piece of news.

The selected players would automatically gather around him to develop a sense of identity. Han Xiao already had a blueprint for the specific operation.

However, how many players he could bring would depend on the situation.

In the secret base, Han Xiao got up from the sofa, went to the equipment warehouse, and entered the password.

A metal wall folded open, revealing a transparent glass cylinder filled with a gel solution. Inside was the Amphiptere mechanical suit that had never been used before.

"It's about time to go."
